name: Conan revisions
auth: Use AW_USER and a short-lived AW_TOKEN whose subject is AW_USER. The server accepts an access/reference token as the Basic password and rechecks the subject and repository permissions. Reading requires read permission; publication requires write permission and replacement may require delete permission.
fresh_home: Run in a disposable client container with a new /work mount, or a new temporary project directory with all the client home/cache paths below. The acceptance harness uses a new scenario directory and container. Never reuse your normal client home for this check.
prerequisites: A Conan 2 conanfile.py and the compiler/build tools required by its recipe.
For Conan 1, use a separate installation and home; enable revisions.

configure.code:
export CONAN_HOME="$(mktemp -d)"
export CONAN_USER_HOME="$CONAN_HOME"
export CONAN_REVISIONS_ENABLED=1
conan remote add aw "$AW_URL/artifactory/api/conan/$AW_REPO"
conan remote login aw "$AW_USER" -p "$AW_TOKEN"
conan profile detect --force
configure.note: Conan 2 commands. Conan 1 uses conan user "$AW_USER" -p "$AW_TOKEN" -r aw and an explicit Conan 1 profile.

publish.note: Publish only to the classes listed here. A federated recipe proves one-node behavior; remote repositories are read-only client sources.

steps.code:
conan create .
conan upload hello/1.0 -r aw -c
steps.note: Use your package reference. Conan 1 uses its user/channel reference and upload --all -c.

install.note: Use the selected repository key. Virtual resolution requires readable configured members; remote resolution requires an administrator-configured upstream.

steps.note: Run from a second fresh CONAN_HOME after adding/logging into aw there, so producer cache contents cannot satisfy this fetch.

limitations: Virtual publication is supported only when its defaultDeploymentRepo is an allowed local member; select that configuration before using V.
The legacy Conan 1 lane requires revisions; its reference and profile syntax differ from Conan 2.

contains: A Basic user name must name the token's subject
